limitations:
### III-A Single-Pass Generation and Context Limitations

Early approaches to LLM-driven MBSE, such as those by Stephan et al. [4], demonstrated the feasibility of translating natural language into SysML/UML syntax. However, these zero-shot, single-pass generation pipelines operate statelessly. While they succeed in generating isolated structural views, they suffer from immediate architectural drift when tasked with generating sequential behavioral views, rendering them incapable of preserving interface compatibility across complex system bounds.
